# dist/

Generated outputs — **do not edit by hand**.

Source: [`sites/`](../sites/) and [`sites.config.json`](../sites.config.json).
Regenerate: `node build.js` from the repo root.

- `userscripts/<name>.user.js` — install via Tampermonkey (recommended) or paste into Hermit.
- `extension/` — load as an unpacked extension in Chrome or Firefox.
